network_scan.label: Enable network scan for discovery
network_scan.description:
Enable network scan for discovery of players. 
Can be used if (some of) your players are not automatically discovered.
Should normally not be needed

household_id.label: Household ID
household_id.description: Household ID for the Sonos (S1) system. Will be auto detected if empty.
